subject: Phantom request IDs on 2026-03-08 usage export
messages:
From: Ana Ruiz <ana.ruiz@helio.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected 1.2M token charge on 2026-03-08

Hi Jordan,

We pulled our March 8th usage export and noticed an unexpected line item: ~1.2M tokens attributed to a single request_id (req_0x4f7b2d). Helio's app logs show no corresponding API call and our instrumentation indicates no user traffic at that minute. I've attached the usage export CSV (usage_export_helio_20260308.csv) with the offending row highlighted.

Can you confirm how that request_id was generated and whether Redwood can reverse or credit this? Also important for our finance team is the VAT treatment if a credit is issued.

Attached: usage_export_helio_20260308.csv

Thanks,
Ana Ruiz
Head of Platform Reliability
Helio AI
ana.ruiz@helio.ai

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Ana Ruiz <ana.ruiz@helio.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected 1.2M token charge on 2026-03-08

Ana — thanks for flagging and for attaching the export. Looping in Ben (billing ops) and Marissa (account lead) to triage. Quick asks from our side to speed root cause:

- Can you paste the exact request_id string as shown in your CSV (looks like req_0x4f7b2d but want to match exactly).
- Any SDK versions / agent versions around that timestamp (2026-03-08T15:42:xxZ) — we often see duplicate events from older SDK retries.
- If you can share a 5-minute window of application logs around 15:40-15:45 UTC, that would help. If you prefer, drop the logs to billing@redwood-internal (we'll treat them as support-only).

We will pull telemetry and correlate server-side trace IDs. If this is an ingestion/duplication issue on Redwood's side we'll propose a credit and a VAT adjustment as needed. Ben — can you own the usage trace and candidate credit? Marissa — I'll keep Ana updated on the account side.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Ana Ruiz <ana.ruiz@helio.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 11:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected 1.2M token charge on 2026-03-08

Ana / Jordan — quick update after a first-pass investigation.

What we found:
- Correlated the request_id from your CSV (req_0x4f7b2d) with our ingestion logs. We see two arrivals for a matching trace within the same second: one from your customer API key (key-helio-prod) and a second which appears to be a replayed batch with identical payload checksum.
- The second arrival was tagged with an older user-agent string (redwood-sdk-js/0.8.2) indicating it likely originated from an out-of-date background job in Helio that retries without idempotency.
- Token accounting: the duplicate contributed ~1.18M extra tokens to the daily aggregate.

Actions proposed:
1) Immediate: we can issue a provisional credit for the duplicated tokens and apply it to your next invoice. We'll include a VAT-adjusted credit note if requested.
2) Preventive: we recommend upgrading to redwood-sdk-js >=1.2.0 which includes idempotent request headers and client-side dedupe guidance. I can share a short patch note.
3) Evidence: attached a small log snippet (sample_ingest_log_snippet.txt) showing both arrivals and the headers.

Questions for Helio:
- Do you want a provisional credit now or prefer us to wait for a formal evidence package before adjusting the invoice?
- For VAT: do you need a corrected invoice (credit memo) or a separate VAT-stamped credit note? Our finance team can produce either.

If you confirm, I'll get a draft credit memo prepared and route to finance for sign-off.

—Ben
Billing Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
Attachment: sample_ingest_log_snippet.txt

From: Ana Ruiz <ana.ruiz@helio.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 17:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected 1.2M token charge on 2026-03-08

Thanks Ben — that log snippet matches what our engineers see when they enable verbose ingestion logs. Confirm Helio will take the provisional credit. We prefer a corrected invoice (credit memo) with VAT treatment called out so our AP team can process it alongside the March invoice.

Next steps from Helio side: we'll schedule an upgrade of the background worker next week to the patched SDK. I also attached a brief PO update request from our procurement team — they will need the credit memo and DocuSign for our amended purchase order.

For Redwood finance: please prepare the credit memo referencing invoice INV-20260301 (March billing cycle) and annotate VAT line(s). Once it's ready we can route signature via DocuSign (link provided by procurement).

Appreciate the fast response.

Best,
Ana Ruiz
Head of Platform Reliability
Helio AI
ana.ruiz@helio.ai
Attachments: credit_proposal_helio.pdf
